Colorful Dragon.name: Tagin' Dragon
Colorful Dragon.summary: 20 challenging levels! Play tag with maze after maze full of dragons. Only a dragon's tail is vulnerable, so sneak up from behind and munch till they turn to bones! If you are fast enough to snatch the magic lantern, you can discover the secrets buried within the walls of each maze.

Raven's Gate.name: Raven's Gate
Raven's Gate.summary: You start your journey as a hero in Golden Forest and your task is to go through world slain' enemies, collecting items and helping humans in quests.

Shera and the 40 Thieves.name: Shera and the 40 Thieves
Shera and the 40 Thieves.summary: A NES Puzzle Platformer from Crazygrouptrio, more commonly known for their Game music arrangements.

Wordle.name: Wordle
Wordle.summary: An unofficial variant of Wordle for the NES.
